items.title: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
items.description: NAZA is an acronym for nezek agavi, Hebrew for "collateral damage." It refers to the number of civilian casualties the Israeli military deems acceptable. The documentary is made by Israeli filmmakers.

items.title: Military AI: France challenges US dominance over NATO's classified networks
items.description: The Arcadia project, unveiled on September 29, aims to massively merge data from the French armed forces to boost their operational effectiveness. A fierce battle has begun against American companies Palantir and Anduril as part of efforts to modernize NATO's structures.
